system.description:
The raiding bands of the Red Waste and the Jotunas marches: ambush, speed and endurance.

  • Ambush Strike: your first hit on a creature that hasn't yet acted this combat knocks it Prone (Fortitude save negates).
    • 9th level: Ambush Strike also works against a creature that can't see you.
  • Raider's Eye: Advantage on Survival checks in harsh terrain, and on checks to read tribal markings and the signs of a raid.
